en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central European square. In the foreground stands a large statue of a man in a cloak (Lajos Kossuth) on a high pedestal decorated with wreaths. To the left is a long, ornate historic building, and to the right is a grand façade with a large round window and arched entrances, likely a public or religious building. People are gathered around the monument and along the paths. The caption at the top reads: "Pécs – Majláth-tér és Kossuth szobor". The reverse side has handwritten text in Hungarian and printed address lines.
